annotations.title: Get postcode regional classification and schools

description: Get every locality/state for one Australian postcode, its regional category (Category 2 or Category 3, or null for non-regional) and associated schools. School addresses match the postcode text and are deduplicated by school code; they are not ranked by distance and may include closed campuses. Regional classification does not determine personal visa eligibility.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

postcode.description: Exactly four digits as a string, including leading zeroes. Use a postcode returned by search_postcodes.
